comments.content: These batch helpers weaken the type safety that the previous `updateGlobalState(context, "key", value)` / `storeSecret(context, "key", value)` calls provided. With `Record<string, any>` + `key as GlobalStateKey`, a typo in a batched property name (e.g. `awsUseCrossRegionInfernce`) is silently accepted and writes to a non-existent memento key instead of failing at compile time. `any` also bypasses the value-type checks.
